tchange_inventory.callgraph_limit: The 121 B/BL edges are bit-decoded static candidates, not independently certified reachable-call edges.

locations.finding: MemoryManager sets _tproEnable only when the apple-vector dyld_hw_tpro key is present; comment distinguishes hardware support from per-process DATA_CONST use.
When dyld_hw_tpro is absent, cache TPRO_CONST uses mprotect transitions.
withReadOnlyTPROMemory has protected-stack and enabled-TPRO branches, followed by an ordinary work() path.
ProtectedStack constructor returns before allocating a stack if isEnabledInProcess is false.
defaultTproStack returns false when defaultTproHW is false. defaultTproHW checks presence of dyld_hw_tpro in the apple vector.

llvm_control_flow_evidence.declarations: AArch64InstrInfo.td 12929-12934 declares all four forms with HasS1POE2 predicate.
llvm_control_flow_evidence.formats: AArch64InstrFormats.td 13684-13713 gives destination GPR plus input GPR/immediate and NB bit. I/EncodedI/AArch64Inst (84-143) do not override branch, terminator or barrier semantics.
llvm_control_flow_evidence.defaults: Target.td 655-674 defaults isBranch, isReturn, isIndirectBranch, isCall, isBarrier, isTrap and isTerminator to false.
llvm_control_flow_evidence.conclusion: LLVM represents the normal execution path as fallthrough. This is compiler implementation evidence and does not remove architectural exceptions or establish CPU feature availability.

arm_exception_reference.section: ISS encoding for an Illegal TIndex Change exception
arm_exception_reference.finding: The architecture describes Illegal TIndex Change exceptions, identifies immediate and register TCHANGEF/TCHANGEB forms separately, and records out-of-range target indices. TCHANGE must not be modeled as a harmless NOP.
arm_exception_reference.full_instruction_asl_review: not completed; the separately retrieved PDF did not yield TCHANGE text matches, so no instruction-operation claim is based on that PDF

remaining_checks: Complete actual early start() incoming branches, including TCHANGE sites near 0x4944 and 0x4aac and references to dyld_hw_tpro=1.
Trace protected-stack constructor callers to connect the observed defaultTproStack gate to every actual constructed object; both endpoints are verified, but all call-site propagation is not.
All TCHANGE and Apple-specific-register sites, including callbacks, must be shown unreachable or supported under the chosen runtime contract.
The port must consistently provide non-TPRO apple-vector and commpage values plus working VM protection semantics; changing a single flag is not an execution test.
Shared-cache code and later loaded libraries have not been covered by this selected dyld audit.
This report neither certifies native execution nor boots iPadOS.
